description: Source code for managing explore state and controls in Apache Superset frontend, including functions for handling deprecated controls, generating control states, and applying default form data.

methods.name: handleDeprecatedControls
methods.description: Handles deprecated form controls, specifically setting y_axis_bounds if y_axis_zero is true.

methods.name: getControlsState
methods.description: Generates the current controls state based on the explore state and input form data, considering the viz type and control registry.

methods.name: applyDefaultFormData
methods.description: Creates a form data object with default values based on controls and input form data.
